mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies and temperatures at 70 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School. The moon is in a waxing crescent phase. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Expect an overnight low of 57 degrees with rain in the forecast.

In city news, the Verona Police Department released a summary of notable calls from October 5 to October 12, ranging from accidents to warrants, ensuring we keep our residents informed on neighborhood safety.

There is plenty to do this week in Verona. Today, enjoy Hop Haus Trivia or Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, look forward to Yoga at Insight Wellness, the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, live music at Paddy Mac's, and trivia nights at The Mill and The Bogey Factory.
Regarding the weekly report, on October 10, a 24-year-old man from Fitchburg was located on Prairie Oaks Drive and taken into custody on an outstanding arrest warrant.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is OREO Cookie Cheesecake. The restaurant is currently open, so feel free to stop by anytime before they close at 10:00 PM tonight.
